_comment: Project-specific preview egg. Review and test with the actual Panel and Wings versions before use.
name: MaplePath Next.js Preview
author: preview@maplepath.example
description: Node 22 source deployment. Upload project files without Windows node_modules or .next. Provision PostgreSQL separately. Run install, migrate, build, then start as explicit actions.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server
printf '%s\n' 'Upload the project source and configure .env before selecting APP_ACTION=install.'

variables.name: Application action
variables.description: One action per Start: install dependencies, migrate database, build application, or start the website. One-off actions exit normally when finished.
